Copy for the Instagram story cards. Edit the words here, then run scripts/render-story-cards.py. Every field is optional except name and big. Use
in 'big' for a deliberate line break. Delete cards you do not want, add as many as you like; they render in this order.

cards.name: what
cards.label: 九州八十八湯
cards.en: 88 hot springs, across one island, on foot.
cards.ja: 九州の温泉を88湯、歩いて巡る。

cards.name: challenge
cards.label: THE CHALLENGE
cards.en: Chosen from an official pool of about 155. Miss one and you find another; the count is what matters, not the list.
cards.ja: 対象は約155湯、そのうち88湯に入れば達成。どの湯を選ぶかは自由。

cards.name: walk
cards.label: THE WALK
cards.en: Every onsen on the line, reached the slow way.
cards.ja: 徒歩で1,200km超、七県をまたぐ。

cards.name: rule
cards.label: THE RULE
cards.en: No trains between onsens, no buses. Just the road, and whatever the road does to you.
cards.ja: 湯から湯へは歩きだけ。電車もバスも使わない。

cards.name: follow
cards.label: FOLLOW
cards.big: A live map of the walk.
cards.en: The route so far, the onsens reached, and my notes from each one.
cards.ja: 歩いた道、入った湯、その記録。
